heading: Small doses of wonder, on repeat.

didYouKnow.question: What was the world’s first form of money made from?
didYouKnow.answer: The earliest coins were struck over 2,600 years ago in ancient Lydia, from electrum — a natural blend of gold and silver panned straight from riverbeds.

curiosity.question: Why does the sky turn orange at sunset, but stay blue all afternoon?
curiosity.note: One question, explored properly, every single week — in the app and in class.

puzzle.question: I have cities, but no houses. I have mountains, but no trees. I have water, but no fish. What am I?
puzzle.hint: Hint: you use me to find your way.
